Credibility tiers: P1 (vector ≥ 0.45, content ≥ 4) recommended with annotation; P2 Weak (vector ≥ 0.35, content ≥ 3) suppressed until explicit expand; discarded if content fails or vector < 0.35. Modifiers: disputed (≥ 3 reviews, rating < 2.0) caps P2; unvetted (0 reviews, 0 applied) caps P1; short content (< 50 chars) downgrades to P2; domain-mismatch penalizes content.

SOUL personas are `soul-<name>` KBs with four constitutional docs plus `soul-config.yml`, evolving via three engines: 补天 distillation (seed, one-shot), curiosity training (4-layer questions: 30 fact/30 concept/20 cross-doc/20 challenge; 4-dim 0–5 self-score plus 10% dual-judge) and RL reinforcement (reward, cognition drafts for dims < 3.5, checkpoint-protected, append-only). All long jobs are non-blocking (task_id polling). Experience meditation spawns an agent harness subprocess; 3 consecutive failures trigger 24 h cooldown; degradation gives confidence 0.3; auto-extracted drafts cap P1. Vector index: one KB → one `kb_{kb_id}` collection, BGE-M3 1024-dim, ChromaDB fallback returns empty.
